method: Each JSON and human-ledger record checked against full primary provision and Guide sentence, not a string-match-only audit. Short excerpts need not contain every condition because full clauses were read.

rows.writer_rule: TFS benefits local authorities; enumerated SA/SAS/SARL/mixed-economy/State companies, in respect of immovables owned.
rows.review_note: Full art.251 enumerates precisely these five forms and ties liability to immovables they possess; local-authority destination is express. No all-IS-company extension.

rows.writer_rule: Whole-year liability fixed on owner or usufructuary at 1 January.
rows.review_note: Full art.252 first sentence fixes the owner/usufructuary at January 1 for the entire year. Guide does not invent a sale apportionment.

rows.writer_rule: Construction-lease liable party is landowner.
rows.review_note: Art.252 second sentence expressly names the owner of the land for a construction lease, not automatically the building user.

rows.writer_rule: Exclusive-object share-company real-estate dealing exemption excludes exploited or non-sale properties.
rows.review_note: Both exclusive-object condition and exceptions for exploited/non-sale properties retained; this is sociétés par action, not all property businesses.

rows.writer_rule: SONAPOST separately exempt.
rows.review_note: Second bullet of art.253 names SONAPOST. No other ordinary exemption is claimed.

rows.writer_rule: Rental value at 1 January less ordinary 50% deduction.
rows.review_note: Full art.254 first paragraph supplies January rental value and 50% deduction for dépérissement/maintenance/repair. Read with next paragraph.

rows.writer_rule: Deduction unavailable where tenant bears major repairs.
rows.review_note: Full art.254 second paragraph removes deduction where grosses réparations are borne by tenant. Ordinary maintenance is not silently equated with major repairs.

rows.writer_rule: Rental value is obtained rent or hypothetical letting rent for owner occupation.
rows.review_note: Art.255(1) runs across pp.107–108: actual letting price or hypothetical rent for self-occupation, supporting case 1.

rows.writer_rule: Value of land/buildings and indispensable immediate construction dependencies included.
rows.review_note: Full art.255(2) covers sols, all buildings and indispensable immediate land dependencies in assessment of the constructions. No cadastral contribution base imported.

rows.writer_rule: Authentic or oral normal leases first; comparison if unavailable.
rows.review_note: Full first two paragraphs of art.255(3): authentic/normal oral leases, then comparison with regularly established or notoriously known rents. Order retained.

rows.writer_rule: If both unavailable, direct appraisal: market value and regional return by property type.
rows.review_note: Third paragraph of art.255(3) permits direct appraisal only if neither earlier procedure applies. Market value, regional average property-return by type and application all retained.

rows.writer_rule: Industrial/commercial land valued by assigned use.
rows.review_note: Art.255(4) applies industrial/commercial land assigned-use valuation. No invented tariff or yield.

rows.writer_rule: Construction lease owner value throughout term: annuity amortising works cost and lessee charges over term.
rows.review_note: Full art.255(5) binds owner throughout construction-lease term and specifies annuity amortising works and lessee charges. Cash ground rent is not substituted; executable annuity method remains held.

rows.writer_rule: TFS 10% on applicable base.
rows.review_note: Art.256 sets 10%. It is on the applicable art.254–255 base, so Guide rejects an unconditional 5%-of-rent rule.

rows.writer_rule: Owner/usufructuary written declaration before 1 November yearly on administration model.
rows.review_note: Full art.257 chapeau: owner/usufructuary where appropriate, before November 1 annually, in writing to assessment agents on administration model. Not a verified payment date.

rows.writer_rule: Declaration refers to production-day facts, distinct from January valuation.
rows.review_note: Art.257 expressly uses day of production for declaration particulars; art.254 uses January 1 for base. Guide preserves both dates.

rows.writer_rule: Tenant identity, premises description, principal rent and applicable charges.
rows.review_note: Full art.257 item 1 read, including tenant personal/corporate identity omitted from short quoted fragment but retained in rule and Guide, let-premises description, principal rent and relevant charges.

rows.writer_rule: Rent-free occupant identity and description of the occupied premises.
rows.review_note: Quote and substance are art.257 item 2. Writer locator 257(2)–(3) is overinclusive but includes exact operative item; item 3 is separately covered by P30. No correction needed.

rows.writer_rule: Replacement article 772 effective 1 January 2026.
rows.review_note: Gazette p.18 article 34 expressly says Pour compter du 1er janvier 2026 before replacing article 772. Publication date January 2 is not substituted for commencement.

rows.writer_rule: Inaccurate/omitted base elements: 25% duties, floor XOF 100,000.
rows.review_note: Full first replacement bullet: declaration inaccuracy/omission of assessment elements, 25% droits dus, XOF100000 floor. Full chapeau identifies TFS/article257, not a generic sanction.

rows.writer_rule: Late payment: 10% duties plus 1% per month or fraction.
rows.review_note: Full second replacement bullet: late payment 10% droits dus plus 1% per month or fraction. Guide does not establish the first late day or sanction accumulation.

rows.writer_rule: Taxation d’office: 25% duties, floor XOF 500,000.
rows.review_note: Full third replacement bullet: taxation d’office, 25% droits dus with XOF500000 floor. Distinct from P20 lower floor. Scanned signed text checked rather than trusting OCR cing.

rows.writer_rule: Built-property general contribution excludes immovables of legal persons subject to TFS.
rows.review_note: Full art.271 exemption list and chapter heading read: general built contribution excludes immovables of legal persons subject to TFS. Does not establish every property-tax exemption.

rows.writer_rule: Unbuilt-property general contribution excludes land of legal persons subject to TFS.
rows.review_note: Full art.273 exemption list and art.272 scope read: corresponding unbuilt contribution exclusion for land of persons subject to TFS. Distinct contribution base and taxable persons read through arts.274–275.

rows.writer_rule: Direct taxes represented by payment notices, assessments or enforceable title.
rows.review_note: Full art.675 names direct taxes and assimilated taxes, bordereaux avis de versement, avis d’imposition or enforceable title. Guide uses as general collection rule only.

rows.writer_rule: General collection date uses declaration/payment deadlines or notice notification; not a specific TFS calendar.
rows.review_note: Full art.677 read, including spontaneous declarations/notices, insufficient spontaneous payment and adjustment branches. Guide does not transform this into a TFS calendar.

rows.writer_rule: General payable-at-deadline rule; notified adjustments immediately due.
rows.review_note: Both paragraphs of art.678 read: general spontaneous payment at due date except express provisions and immediate exigibility of notified adjustments. Art.679 additional triggers also read; enforcement remains held.

rows.writer_rule: Statutory payment methods subject to conditions; every payment has an official receipt.
rows.review_note: Full art.671 read: enumerated legal methods and conditions, relevant dating rules, universal official receipt. No authenticated channel or operative electronic ministerial instrument is claimed.

rows.writer_rule: Record payment amount, date and receipt number on assessments/declarations.
rows.review_note: Full art.672 requires mention on notices/declarations of total/partial payment, date and receipt number. Guide carries these particulars.

rows.writer_rule: Description of vacant premises also required.
rows.review_note: Art.257 item 3 expressly requires description of vacant premises; Guide has separate bullet. No vacancy exemption invented.
